title: Half of a Cake Recipe  (半张蛋糕食谱)

segments.t: 泰莎把下一件纸质发现带回明亮的咖啡厅柜台，欧文刚拎着星期六的水果篮来到这里，伊芙琳也好奇地凑上前看。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
Morning, everyone! Arthur told me at the gate that you dug up buried treasure!
Better than gold coins, Owen — look at this cream kitchen card from the tin!
Summer Berry and Almond Courtyard Cake — written in neat blue fountain pen!
Two hundred grams of ground almonds, soft butter, three eggs, and fresh summer berries...
Why did you stop reading at the best part, Tessa?
Because someone tore the recipe card cleanly in half right across the middle!
Turn the half card over, my dear — there is a penciled note on the back.
Read it aloud, Tessa! Where did they hide the baking time and the glaze?
Half in the tin, half pressed inside our favorite green book of garden leaves!
A recipe split into two halves like a treasure map — who bakes like that?!
Two clever friends who wanted us to search both the courtyard and the bookshelves!
Until we find that green leaf book, nobody gets a single slice of berry cake!
现在我们逐句回顾大家端详那半张食谱卡的情景。
Morning, everyone! Arthur told me at the gate that you dug up buried treasure!
“大家早！亚瑟在门口告诉我你们挖出了埋藏的宝藏！”熟人之间随和的早安问候常省去 Good：
Morning, everyone!
而过去式短语动词 dug up（原形 dig up）搭配经典的表达：
dug up buried treasure
Better than gold coins, Owen — look at this cream kitchen card from the tin!
“欧文，这可比金币还宝贵——快看从铁盒里拿出来的这张米白色厨房卡片！”对一位烘焙师来说，一张古老的食谱比金子还珍贵：
Better than gold coins
写在象牙白或米白色的卡片上：
this cream kitchen card
Summer Berry and Almond Courtyard Cake — written in neat blue fountain pen!
“‘夏日浆果杏仁庭院蛋糕’——用工整的蓝色钢笔写的呢！”在英语中，表示用什么工具或墨水书写，固定使用介词 in：
written in neat blue fountain pen
Two hundred grams of ground almonds, soft butter, three eggs, and fresh summer berries...
“两百克杏仁粉、软化的黄油、三个鸡蛋，还有新鲜的夏日浆果……”过去分词 ground（源自 grind，“研磨”）在这里表示“磨成粉的”：
Two hundred grams of ground almonds
这是杏仁甜点烘烤的传统原料。
Why did you stop reading at the best part, Tessa?
“泰莎，怎么念到最精彩的地方停下来了？”动词 stop 后接动名词 -ing，意为“停下正在做的动作”：
Why did you stop reading
恰好卡在最关键的那一段，用介词 at 引出：
at the best part
Because someone tore the recipe card cleanly in half right across the middle!
“因为有人把这张食谱卡从正中间整齐地撕成两半了！”不规则过去式 tore（原形 tear，“撕破”）搭配短语 in half（“一分为二、成两半”）：
tore the recipe card cleanly in half
Turn the half card over, my dear — there is a penciled note on the back.
“亲爱的，把那半张卡片翻过来——背面有铅笔写的小字呢。”可分离短语动词 turn over 意为“翻面、翻转过来”：
Turn the half card over
翻到背面就能看到：
a penciled note on the back
Read it aloud, Tessa! Where did they hide the baking time and the glaze?
“泰莎，大声念出来！他们把烘烤时间和糖霜配方藏哪儿了？”副词 aloud（“大声地”）紧跟在宾语后面：
Read it aloud
而大家急切想知道的两项烘焙秘诀正是：
the baking time and the glaze
Half in the tin, half pressed inside our favorite green book of garden leaves!
“‘一半放在铁盒里，另一半压在我们最喜欢的那本绿封皮园艺树叶图鉴里！’”形容花朵或卡片夹在合拢的书页之间，常用过去分词 pressed：
half pressed inside
就夹在被称为的那本书里：
our favorite green book
A recipe split into two halves like a treasure map — who bakes like that?!
“一张拆成两半、活像藏宝图一样的食谱——谁做蛋糕会这么烤啊？！”过去分词不变形的 split（“劈开，分成”）后接 into 及 half 的不规则复数 halves：
A recipe split into two halves
最后以一句打趣的反问收尾：
who bakes like that?!
Two clever friends who wanted us to search both the courtyard and the bookshelves!
“两位聪明的友人，想让我们既翻找庭院，又去搜寻书架！”英语结构 want + 宾语 + 带 to 的不定式，用来表达“希望某人去做某事”：
wanted us to search
而关联连词 both ... and 把两处搜寻地点串在了一起：
both the courtyard and the bookshelves
Until we find that green leaf book, nobody gets a single slice of berry cake!
“在咱们找到那本绿封皮树叶书之前，谁也别想吃到哪怕一块浆果蛋糕！”在时间连词 until（“直到……为止”）引导的从句中，英语要用一般现在时表将来：
Until we find
起强调作用的形容词 single 让这句半开玩笑的“禁令”更加俏皮：
nobody gets a single slice
让我们从头到尾再完整听一遍整段对话。

Better than gold coins, Owen — look at this cream kitchen card from the tin!

Two hundred grams of ground almonds, soft butter, three eggs, and fresh summer berries...

Because someone tore the recipe card cleanly in half right across the middle!
Turn the half card over, my dear — there is a penciled note on the back.
Read it aloud, Tessa! Where did they hide the baking time and the glaze?
Half in the tin, half pressed inside our favorite green book of garden leaves!
A recipe split into two halves like a treasure map — who bakes like that?!
Two clever friends who wanted us to search both the courtyard and the bookshelves!
Until we find that green leaf book, nobody gets a single slice of berry cake!
配料清单已经一清二楚，但烤箱温度和秘制糖霜却藏在一本神秘的绿色园艺树叶图鉴里！待会儿见。
See you next time!
